package com.convoscribe.audio

/**
 * Conversions between raw PCM16 sample storage (16-bit signed `Short`
 * arrays) and the `FloatArray` shape the ASR and diarization
 * pipelines expect.
 *
 * PCM16 covers `[-32768, 32767]`, so dividing by 32 768f maps the
 * range to approximately `[-1.0, 1.0]`. The 0.5 dB asymmetry
 * (`-32768 / 32768 == -1.0` but `32767 / 32768 ≈ 0.99997`) is what
 * every other ASR tool does, so we match the convention rather than
 * exact mathematical symmetry.
 */

/**
 * Convert a buffer of signed 16-bit PCM samples to floats in
 * `[-1.0, 1.0]` (each value divided by 32 768f). Returns a new
 * array; the receiver is not modified.
 */
fun ShortArray.toFloatSamples(): FloatArray {
    val out = FloatArray(size)
    for (i in indices) {
        out[i] = this[i] / 32_768f
    }
    return out
}

/**
 * Convert a sample count to milliseconds at [sampleRate] (defaults
 * to [AudioSpec.SAMPLE_RATE]). Used to translate streaming ASR
 * timestamps and `AudioRecord` chunk counts into the millisecond
 * range the UI and the diarization segments share.
 */
fun samplesToMs(samples: Long, sampleRate: Int = AudioSpec.SAMPLE_RATE): Long = samples * 1000L / sampleRate.toLong()

package com.convoscribe.data

import androidx.room.Entity
import androidx.room.Index
import androidx.room.PrimaryKey

/**
 * A speaker enrolled by the user in v2: a name plus the
 * speaker-embedding vector (a [ByteArray] of little-endian
 * float32, see [EmbeddingCodec]) the diarizer emits for a
 * short voice sample. Enrolled rows are global — they are not
 * scoped to a session, so the same enrollment is reused across
 * every recording.
 *
 * The unique index on [name] is what makes
 * [EnrolledSpeakerDao.upsertByName] safe: saving the same
 * `name` twice replaces the existing row's [embedding] /
 * [createdAt] without producing duplicates.
 */
@Entity(
    tableName = "enrolled_speakers",
    indices = [Index(value = ["name"], unique = true)]
)
data class EnrolledSpeakerEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val name: String,
    val embedding: ByteArray,
    val createdAt: Long
) {
    /**
     * [ByteArray] equality is reference-based, which would make
     * Room emit spurious "row changed" notifications when the
     * embedding is reassigned. We compare contents instead so
     * two rows with the same name + same floats collapse to
     * `equals` and a replacement shows up as a real change.
     */
    override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean {
        if (this === other) return true
        if (other !is EnrolledSpeakerEntity) return false
        if (id != other.id) return false
        if (name != other.name) return false
        if (!embedding.contentEquals(other.embedding)) return false
        if (createdAt != other.createdAt) return false
        return true
    }

    override fun hashCode(): Int {
        var result = id.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + name.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + embedding.contentHashCode()
        result = 31 * result + createdAt.hashCode()
        return result
    }
}
